iterate_obfuscation_tokens: iterate over all VAR, FUNC, and CLASS obfuscation tokens for code preprocessing
generate_obfuscation_tokens_without_erro: generate obfuscation tokens without raising an error when exhausted by passing raise_finished=False
obfuscate_variables: obfuscate variable names in source code using VAR_%i placeholder tokens
obfuscate_functions: obfuscate function names in source code using FUNC_%i placeholder tokens
obfuscate_classes: obfuscate class names in source code using CLASS_%i placeholder tokens
